# Vishal Tools Enterprise - LLM Information Guide

Vishal Tools Enterprise is a premier precision engineering and industrial machinery manufacturer based in Makarpura, Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Proudly participating in the "Make in India" initiative and certified to ISO 9001:2015 standards, the company has delivered high-durability machined components, specialized tooling, and custom industrial machinery to domestic and global markets for over 25 years.

---

## 2. Company Scale & Facility Details
- **Units Manufactured**: Over 500,000+ precision units and components built since inception.
- **Global Reach**: Proudly serving 50+ industrial markets worldwide.
- **Customer Base**: Spans from emerging local SMEs to global industrial conglomerates in the automotive, aerospace, heavy machinery, agriculture, mining, and energy sectors.
- **Facilities**: Fully equipped CNC/VMC vertical machining labs, high-precision cylindrical and surface grinders, spark erosion EDM units, sheet metal die-press lines, and dedicated metrology testing laboratories.

---

## 3. Product Catalog
The company manufactures components grouped into 8 key product categories. Custom orders can be manufactured to user-supplied blueprints, materials (Mild Steel, Stainless Steel, Brass, Copper, Alloys), and tolerances.

### A. CNC & Job Work Services (ID: `cnc-services`)
High-precision machining for complex profiles, hardened tool steels, and small or large batches.
- **CNC Turning**: Features positioning accuracy of ±0.01mm, max length 1000mm, max diameter 400mm. Used for automotive shafts, gears, flanges, and hydraulic valve bodies.
- **CNC Milling & VMC**: Vertical machining centers with 24-station automatic tool changers, table size up to 1000x500mm, accuracy ±0.02mm. Used for machine bases, manifolds, and aerospace brackets.
- **EDM Job Work (Electrical Discharge Machining)**: Spark erosion for hard metals up to 65 HRC with zero mechanical stress and Ra 0.4 microns finish. Ideal for deep cavities and plastic molds.
- **CNC Wire Cutting**: Precision wire erosion using 0.15-0.25mm brass wire, accuracy ±0.005mm.

### B. Grinding & Spindle Repairs (ID: `grinding-spindle`)
Precision dimensional finishing and rebuilds for heavy machinery components.
- **Cylindrical Grinding**: Achieves micron-level concentricity and mirror finishes on industrial shafts and rollers.
- **Spindle Repair**: Complete disassembly, balancing, bearing replacement, and runout testing to restore machine tool spindles to OEM specs.

### C. Dies & Punches (ID: `dies-punches`)
Hardened press tools and precision punch assemblies.
- **Press Tool Dies**: Custom stamping, forming, and blanking dies.
- **Progressive Tooling**: Multi-station dies for high-volume sheet metal part production.

### D. Pellet & Hammer Mill Components (ID: `pellet-hammer`)
Heavy-duty replacement parts for processing and milling machinery.
- **Pellet Mill Dies**: Specially drilled ring dies for animal feed and biomass pelleting.
- **Hammer Mill Beaters & Hammer Blades**: Hardfaced and balanced blades designed for maximum wear resistance in pulverizers and hammer mills.

### E. Shafts, Gears & Bearings (ID: `shafts-gears`)
Industrial transmission components designed to withstand high torque and load.
- **Cylindrical Shafts**: Precision-ground spline shafts, keyed shafts, and axle rods.
- **Splined Gears**: Spur, helical, and bevel gears machined to custom teeth profiles.

### F. Hydraulics & Presses (ID: `hydraulics`)
Fluid power assemblies for manufacturing and assembly systems.
- **Hydraulic Cylinders**: Custom single-acting and double-acting pistons, rods, and cylinder bodies.
- **Press Components**: Bolsters, columns, and guide pins for industrial hydraulic presses.

### G. Rollers, Bushings & Conveyors (ID: `rollers-bushings`)
Material handling parts and wear components.
- **Bronze Bushings**: Self-lubricating and grooved bushings for pivot points.
- **Conveyor Rollers**: Heavy-duty idlers, drive rollers, and conveyor shaft assemblies.

---

## 4. Website Navigation & Mapping
Crawlers can locate details and initiate inquiries on the following paths:
- **Home**: `/` (Overview, company highlights, core services, and lead capture form)
- **Product Index**: `/categories` (Master list of all product categories)
- **Product Category Routes**:
  - `/categories/cnc-services` (CNC Turning, Milling, EDM, VMC)
  - `/categories/grinding-spindle` (Spindle Repair, Surface & Cylindrical Grinding)
  - `/categories/dies-punches` (Hardened punches, press tools)
  - `/categories/pellet-hammer` (Mill components, beaters, ring dies)
  - `/categories/shafts-gears` (Ground shafts, transmission splines)
  - `/categories/hydraulics` (Hydraulic pistons, press pillars)
  - `/categories/rollers-bushings` (Bronze bushings, conveyor rollers)
  - `/categories/misc-machined` (Specialized fixtures, custom turned parts)
- **Product Details Route**: `/products/[product_id]` (Example: `/products/cnc-1` for MS CNC turning specifications, descriptions, features, and instant WhatsApp inquiry)
- **About Us Page**: `/about` (Company history since 1998, core engineering values, and certifications)
- **Contact Page**: `/contact` (Interactive Google Map, physical address, phone directories, and direct email)
